summary: Datasea Intelligent Technology Ltd. filed a Form 6-K disclosing that Nasdaq granted an additional 180-day period, until March 22, 2027, to regain compliance with the $1.00 minimum bid price rule (Listing Rule 5550(a)(2)). The original notice dated March 27, 2026 gave a first compliance window expiring September 23, 2026; the company's Class A ordinary shares must close at or above $1.00 for at least ten consecutive business days before the Compliance Date. Nasdaq cited compliance with all other continued listing standards and the company's written intent to cure via a reverse stock split if necessary. Failure to cure would trigger a delisting notice, appealable to a Nasdaq Hearings Panel. Key angle: reverse-split timing and potential share overhang; no pricing terms set.
